# Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-303#speed-up-slowest-dashboard-checks

**Outcome: Assertion gap.**

A maintained check exercised the independently observed wrong behavior on the partial Taken path, yet its thin assertion passed. The next proof action is to strengthen that observing assertion.

## What was checked

- **Story and revision.** `.planning/seeds/SEED-303-speed-up-slowest-dashboard-checks.md#speed-up-slowest-dashboard-checks` (SEED-303#speed-up-slowest-dashboard-checks), plan `.planning/slice-plans/580-speed-up-slowest-dashboard-checks/PLAN.md`, at checked revision `3e8a3e7c1e47219d904a68fcadae67fee584911d`. Isolated detached scratch worktree at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-303-speed-up-slowest-dashboard-checks-scratch` (pre-probe: only `?? node_modules` symlink to the execution checkout; 0 product paths dirty). Execution checkout unused for edits.
- **Promise (validated from story / product contract).** Pending Take protection through stale, unrelated, comparison failure/recovery, and partial accepted reads keeps Taken actions unavailable while Select story stays available and source links remain readable on the protected card (StoryCard contract; `expectProtected` in `dashboard/tests/responsiveStart.ts`). Reused the product-review hint about thin `expectActionsUnavailable` after compare/partial missing Select story / source-link rechecks that full `expectProtected` covered only once at stale. Mark-uniqueness vs `lastInRotation` was the alternate hint; this probe chose the protection-gap target as the stronger catchable concern for wrap-up disposition.
- **Fault.** In `dashboard/src/StoryCard.tsx`, changed the protected-card source-link gate from `{!inspected && starting && (` to `{!inspected && starting && offersStart && (`. Taken cards pass `offersStart: false`, so a protected Taken card no longer shows Canonical-record source links while still leaving Inspect disabled and exactly one enabled control. Fixtures and maintained assertions were left intact. The `offersStart` gate was chosen so the one full `expectProtected` at stale (Backlog, `offersStart: true`) still passes and the journey reaches the later thin helpers.
- **Maintained checks / assertion examined.** Focused command, unchanged for baseline, fault, and restoration:

```sh
caffeinate -s -i npm run --silent test:dashboard -- --workers=1 --reporter=list --grep "a Take.s older snapshot arriving late"
```

 Case: `dashboard/tests/launches/responsive-session-reconciliation.spec.ts` — “a Take's older snapshot arriving late…”. After one full `expectProtected(story)` at stale, later protection uses local `expectActionsUnavailable` (enabled-button count 1 + Inspect disabled only) at compare-failure, unrelated recovery, and partial Taken (`expectActionsUnavailable(takenStory)`).
- **Runs and reach.** Baseline: 1 passed (Playwright total 20.0s; case 8.2s). Fault: 1 passed (total 13.0s; case 8.6s), including the partial `expectActionsUnavailable(takenStory)` call. Independent witness while the fault remained active: the same focused command with a temporary source-link visibility/href check added only inside `expectActionsUnavailable` (maintained thin checks otherwise unchanged) failed at the Taken partial call (`expectActionsUnavailable(takenStory)`), locator Canonical-record source link not found / not visible after 5s. Compare-failure and unrelated thin calls on the Backlog card still had links under this fault and were reached before that failure. Spec restored to byte match immediately after the witness; product fault still present for that observation. Restoration: `StoryCard.tsx` restored to HEAD; scratch status again only `?? node_modules` (matched pre-probe); focused command 1 passed (total 13.0s; case 8.4s).
- **Verdict basis.** Wrong behavior on the exercised partial Taken path: protected Taken card missing source links. The maintained thin assertion on that same call passed. Bound to the examined pending-Take case and its thin helper; this probe does not claim absence of Select-story coverage failure modes, and mark uniqueness was not faulted.

## Next proof action

Strengthen the observing assertion on the post-stale protection path: extend `expectActionsUnavailable` (or restore full `expectProtected`) so compare/partial states also recheck source-link readability (and Select story when that half is the concern), rather than only disabled Inspect + single enabled control.

## Already-planned recognition

Matches the execution-complete product advice / wrap-up Intent Coverage hint on thin `expectActionsUnavailable` after compare/partial (Select story / source-link rechecks). That is recognition of the supplied review concern, not a new repair decision invented by this probe alone.

## Wrap-up disposition

- Outcome: Assertion gap
- Decision: story closure proceeds; queue routine authorized test strengthening
- Follow-up: SEED-324#strengthen-pending-take-protection-assertions (Backlog first)
- Rationale: Thin `expectActionsUnavailable` after stale leaves Taken Canonical-record source-link omission green; that gap is out of SEED-303's 45s/busy-ratio measure and belongs in a separate strengthening story already planted and queued.
